refinement.title: Improve & filter (step 6)
refinement.hint: Indoor only: Depth-Anything-V2 predicts depth where COLMAP finds no texture (white walls) and helps to remove floating points and to fill floors, ceilings and walls.
refinement.depth_fill: Fill gaps with Depth Anything (only where it agrees with the COLMAP depth maps)
refinement.surface_fusion: Merge surfaces: fuse all depth maps into one point layer (one plane each for wall, ceiling and floor)
